sources: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-parks/park.html?id=spk00254 (MN DNR Wild River State Park; record read via maps.dnr.state.mn.us feature_detail id=spk00254, alerts 'Last updated November 3, 2026'; read 2026-11-11)
ReserveMN (UseDirect) PlaceId 106, facility 895 'Wild River Campground': unit catalog and per-unit rates for 2027-03-05 via mnrdr.usedirect.com rdr/search/details (read 2026-11-11)

values.note: ReserveMN: drive-in site $25 a night, electric $35; the two double sites $50.

fees.source: ReserveMN facility 895 unit rates for 2027-03-05 (56 'Drive-In' back-ins and 2 pull-throughs at $25.00, 33 'Drive-In Electric' at $35.00, 2 'Drive-In Double Site' at $50.00), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: ReserveMN facility 895 catalog (Drive-In Electric units list 'Electric 30, 50') + DNR ('The park has 34 electric sites ... There are no full hookups.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Mostly gravel back-ins; two non-electric pull-throughs (82 and 93). ReserveMN lists 93 sites (33 electric, 2 doubles); the DNR says 94 drive-in and 34 electric. Spurs on ReserveMN run 27-75 ft, most 40-60 ft.

sites.source: DNR ('There are 94 drive-in sites.'; 'There are two pull-through sites. Neither are electric.'; 'The maximum RV length is 60 feet.'; 'The park has typical gravel back-in sites that vary in spur length.') + ReserveMN facility 895 catalog (93 units, VehicleLength 27-75), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: DNR overnight facilities ('Showers are available seasonally in the campground.'; 'Flush toilets are available seasonally in the campground.'; Vault Toilets 'Throughout the park'; Dump Station 'Seasonal'; 'Water and a hose are available at the ranger station year-round.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Camping year-round in the main campground; in winter only lane D (four electric sites) and lane E (non-electric) stay open, with campground water, showers and the dump station off; water at the ranger station.

season.source: DNR seasonal update ('Camping is available year-round in the main campground.'; 'The park has 34 electric sites, four of these remain open through the winter.'; 'In winter, electric sites are available in the campground's D lane. Non-electric winter campsites are available in the E lane.'; 'Water is off for the season in the campground ... The dump station is closed.'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: DNR seasonal update ('All sites are 100% reservable. Reservations are taken up to 120 days in advance.') + ReserveMN PlaceId 106 (all 93 units AllowWebBooking true), read 2026-11-11

note: Wild River State Park's drive-in campground, in woods on the upland above the St. Croix River, with screening between sites. The park also has camper cabins, a horse camp and backpack and canoe-in sites. --Claude
summary: DNR record (spk00254) + ReserveMN facility 895 read: $25 / electric $35 confirmed (50 amp); 93 sites on ReserveMN (DNR 94), max 60 ft (spurs 27-75), 2 non-electric pull-throughs; showers/flush/dump seasonal; camping year-round (lanes D/E in winter). Pin ~2 km off: move to the unit centroid. Phone and DNR link added. Not waterfront kept.
